title: Polished Brass Paper Towel Holder, 14-Inch Freestanding Solid Brass Countertop Stand, Contemporary Style, Allied Brass
description: Paper towel holder, 14-inch H x 5-inch L x 5-inch W, solid brass freestanding countertop stand for kitchen paper towels — available in Polished Brass that which brings warm, golden elegance that complements traditional faucets and classic kitchens fixtures. Contemporary, modern crisp design with a weighted base to prevent tipping and a felt pad to help protect countertop surfaces. No wall mounting required; keeps paper towels accessible while reducing countertop clutter. Corrosion-free, rust-free performance with a designer finish and a limited lifetime warranty. Includes paper towel holder. Ideal for kitchen islands, prep stations, and coffee bars where a freestanding paper towel valet is preferred over wall-mounted options. Allied Brass.
